g.text: Exact purchased boards • top and underside XIAO views • 1S LiPo • two-resistor divider
CORRECTED: TWO external 200 kΩ resistors are required. Do not use the superseded one-resistor Climate diagram.
USB-C ↑ TOP · antenna ↓ BOTTOM · do not mirror
LEFT ROW USED → D0/A0 · D2 · D3
If headers are installed, connect to the header pin—or to any breadboard
hole in the same numbered row on that same side of the center groove.
Colored ring = connect · pale gray = no wire in this build
USB-C and the antenna end are intentionally shown.
Blue sensor TOP · pins point DOWN · labels read + / OUT / −
Connector shell and wire color are not proof of polarity. Check the delivered pair with a multimeter before the first
USB-C ↑ TOP · underside view · do not mirror
BATTERY VOLTAGE DIVIDER — TWO EXTERNAL RESISTORS
Corrected topology: BAT+ → R1 → A0 → R2 → GND
R1 and R2 are both from the ordered 200 kΩ 1% pack.
There is no onboard A0 pull-down resistor to substitute for R2.
Match the printed labels; do not infer position from wire color.
XIAO GND → DHT11 − and one lead of R2
Meter-verified pigtail + wire → underside BAT+; the same BAT+ node → R1
R1 other lead + R2 other lead join at XIAO D0/A0
USB-C is only for flashing/charging; it is not a permanent internal wire
• R1 = 200 kOhm from BAT+ to A0. R2 = 200 kOhm from A0 to GND. Both resistors are external and required.
• Do not trust connector colors or shell orientation: unplug everything and verify +/− with a multimeter before soldering.
• Solder the underside BAT pads and divider before applying mounting tape; insulate every exposed splice with heat-shrink.
Exact purchase references: B0DJ6N55FX · B0DQ3PPGH2 · B0FZSR8MQY · B07FP2FCYC · B08QRKSH5C · B0BPXKJSWY
